fidelity_limits: The coordinate method supplies candidate ask/tell only; no candidate is a result until it has fresh candidate.apply, simulation.run, evaluation.run and control.profile_report, and the frozen comparison is reported separately from raw scalar objectives (F1616).

Sampled holding coverage is the final 0.05 s only, 6 samples (F1481 candidate, F1670 baseline) with continuous_time_guarantee false (F1514, F1587); no continuous-time settling guarantee can be claimed from this plan's outputs.

Frames stay distinct: world for tip position/velocity metrics, projected GVS coordinates for controller state, serial backend joint coordinates for q/qdot; applied inputs are simulated backend readbacks, distinct from requested commands and from hardware force measurement.

Per-update effective_horizon, per-term cost contributions and full warm plans are only partially retained (historical_full_plans not retained); controller-side plan records such as optimization_raw_status and optimization_selected_iteration cover exactly the listed update IDs and are not causal evidence.
This plan executes no batch and promotes no candidate: it is a milestone handoff requiring a future grant, and local/raw weighted costs cannot serve as final physical ranking.
arguments.hypothesis: A bounded coordinate search over control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight (saved start 0.05 and 0.0 respectively; both domains [0,1]; coordinate step 0.25) can move the sampled final-window holding position error and holding tip speed toward the frozen settling limits (0.01 m, 0.02 m/s) while preserving the already-passing terminal reach (0.01 m), and can test whether a larger hold tip-speed penalty or a nonzero terminal tip-speed penalty changes the recorded reach/holding outcome relative to candidate improvement-96f0ade35119. The recorded single paired change holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05 reduced sampled hold speed by 0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1596) yet left the candidate at 1.1750052670100422 m/s (F1310) against a 0.02 m/s limit (F1745), so whether any tested weight pair attains joint acceptance is an open, testable question rather than a prediction.
arguments.rationale:
Scope and honest framing. This is a future SearchBatchPlan linked to the accepted single-context diagnosis and the factual audit; it authorizes nothing here and promotes no candidate. The plan is uncertain rather than promising because the only executed paired change was a weight-only move whose effect was small relative to the gap: sampled hold speed fell 0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1596) yet stayed at 1.1750052670100422 m/s (F1310) versus 0.02 m/s (F1745), and hold position stayed at 0.05650455971948983 m/s-equivalent error (F1538) versus 0.01 m (F1712), while the sealed comparison is classified physical_tradeoff (F1324) with joint_reach_holding_passed false on both sides (F1278, F1541). It is not 'unlikely' only because one authorized coordinate, control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight, is recorded at 0.0 (F2407) and has never been exercised at nonzero value, so the tested region is genuinely open. No claim of a dominant cause or of ineffectiveness throughout a parameter range is made: the recorded observations cover exactly the listed update IDs, controller-side plan records (e.g. optimization_raw_status User_Requested_Stop at F168, update_wall_s 17.69917060015723 s against a 0.01 s period at F169) are not backend motion, and applied tensions reaching 7.999987676698501 N at update 32 remain inside the 8.0 N limit (F157) — legal near-bound input is not a violation. Raw optimizer termination and controller policy stops are separate facts and neither is treated as the cause of the holding outcome. Observations, hypotheses and proposed tests are kept separate: the observations above motivate the test; they do not pre-decide it.

Variables, domains, start values and step legality. Exactly the two authorized builder paths are varied — control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight and control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight — each with the existing granted bounds [0,1], which are legal because each bound is either exactly zero or at least 0.0001. The saved starting values, 0.05 (holding) and 0.0 (terminal, F2407), lie inside their domains. The coordinate step 0.25 lies in (0,1] and, applied from 0.05, yields 0.05, 0.30, 0.55, 0.80 and a bound-clamped 1.00, and from 0.0 yields 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 and 1.00; no generated coordinate is a forbidden tiny positive, and zero is produced only where the saved value already is zero. Proposals include the start configuration itself and may include duplicate points, so at most six candidates are requested and the plan does not treat duplicates as distinct evidence.

Fixed conditions and controls. Robot, task, acceptance, controller implementation and other numerical settings are fixed; the controller is controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 and the task/acceptance contract, evaluator tolerance and timing settings are unchanged, so any measured difference is attributed only to the two varied recipe weights within their tested coordinate set. search.family_coordinate@1.0.0 supplies ask/tell candidates only; a bounded future evaluation and the frozen comparison are required before any physical statement is made, and raw weighted objectives under different weights are not ranked (F1616).

Budget and protection. Planned budget is 3 backend solves, 24 tool calls (within 12-60), 8 model calls (at most 16), 0 workers and 3600 s wall (within 2970-7200), with max_backend_attempts=3, target_changed_configurations=2 and failure_policy stop_on_material_failure. Roughly 600 s and four provider/tool slots are deliberately held back for interpretation and delivery, consistent with stopping normally after two distinct changed configurations complete simulation, evaluation and profile. No separate numerical screening and no new baseline are requested; the retained baseline and its sealed comparison stay the comparison basis. A small unsuccessful batch would describe only the tested candidates, not the parameter range.
stopping_conditions: Stop normally as soon as TWO distinct changed configurations have complete simulation, evaluation and profile, even if joint reach-holding acceptance is reached earlier; do not spend a third configuration.

Stop immediately on material failure of any candidate stage under failure_policy stop_on_material_failure; the separate max_backend_attempts=3 cap governs new full backend attempts and is never exceeded to repair a failed candidate.
Stop and report partial coverage if fewer than two distinct changed configurations complete while backend attempts are exhausted at 3.
Stop with the protected 600 s and four provider/tool slots left unspent for interpretation and delivery; do not begin another configuration once that reserve would be consumed.
Stop and report a coverage gap rather than inferring absent data if a required artifact (evaluation, profile, bound comparison) is unavailable for a launched configuration.
weakening_observations: The one paired change actually executed (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05) improved sampled hold speed only marginally against the gap: candidate_minus_baseline holding_max_speed_m_s = -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1596) while the candidate still reads 1.1750052670100422 m/s (F1310) versus the 0.02 m/s limit (F1745), and holding_speed_passed is false (F1541 component context; F1385). Holding-position improvement is also sub-threshold: delta -0.001633544566242727 m (F1465) with candidate 0.05650455971948983 m (F1538) versus the 0.01 m limit (F1712).

Terminal reach worsened under the recorded change: candidate_minus_baseline terminal_error_m = +0.001056295661744434 m (F1546) with candidate 0.00869890424761182 m (F1698) still inside the 0.01 m tolerance (F1740) and reach_passed true (F1742); a weight-only lever already consumed part of that margin, so it cannot be treated as free.
The sealed comparison remains a trade-off, not an improvement: classification physical_tradeoff (F1324) with joint_reach_holding_passed false for both baseline (F1278) and candidate (F1541).

Compute-budget saturation is unaffected by the recorded weight change and remains an untested confounder: deadline_misses is 35 in both runs (F1341 candidate, F1411 baseline) and the delta is 0 (F1696), while mean complete-update time rose by 0.5154540428891785 s (F1433).

Performed-check plan records keep budget-limited selection in view but are controller-side values, not backend motion or causal evidence: optimization_raw_status is User_Requested_Stop at sampled update 28 (F168) and policy stop is budget-limited while update_wall_s at sampled update 16 is 17.69917060015723 s against the 0.01 s control period (F169); sampled applied tensions reach 7.999987676698501 N at update 32 but never exceed the 8.0 N per-tendon limit (F157), so zero bound violation does not by itself exclude legal near-bound loading.

The summary records terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 (F2407), i.e. the second authorized coordinate has never been exercised at a nonzero value, so its effect on the recorded holding failure is untested rather than known to be ineffective.
